posts.title: Running individual Bun tests with Zed tasks
posts.description: I’m a big fan of the Zed editor. It’s been my daily driver (when I’ve had a choice) for around a year now. It runs like butter on an ancient nine-year-old Dell XPS that’s been my Arch Linux hobby machine for a while. posts.title: Vibe-Coding BlueSky Comments
posts.description: I’ve vibe-coded a new commenting system for this blog using BlueSky as the backend. At the bottom of the page you’ll see a call to action to “Join the conversation on BlueSky” which takes you to a BlueSky post. Any replies to that post will also appear at the bottom of the page, there might even be some there now.
